DESCRIPTION:
Why this test is automated: it guards against fraud that only the API can show.

    Anyone can send JSON to the API. If the server trusted client-sent odds, payout or
    balance, a customer could set their own price or top up their own balance. The UI
    cannot prevent that; only the server can (SPEC §5.3 "Extra fields may be ignored",
    DA-G11). It is fast, needs no browser, and a failure is unambiguous.
NAME: TC-03: client-supplied odds, payout and balance are ignored

DESCRIPTION:
Why this test is automated: it is the journey that earns money.

    It runs the whole customer path once (select odds, enter a stake, place, read the
    receipt, close) and checks that slip, receipt, header and API agree on every amount.
    A break anywhere here means no bets, or bets charged or paid at the wrong amount.
NAME: TC-01: a single bet is placed and the receipt and balance agree
